Rae (CSM): Heads-up — Veridian's QBR in 5 days. Noticed a sharp cost change after their Contextual Insights launch. Need a 1-slide summary + mitigation asks.
Hector (FinOps): 5d spike +170% vs baseline. If sustained, month ~ $38k vs baseline $14k. Running a 30d scenario now.
alerts-bot: Budget alert: account veridian-prod crossed soft threshold (daily $5.6k) at 2026-05-18T10:11Z.
Noah (Solutions Eng): Likely drivers: per-message embedding + gen for preview cards. Quick wins: batch embeds, route non-UI flows to emb-small, try 512->256 dim trial.
Ivy (Onboarding): I'll request top 500 queries and a 1k sample. Can we offer a 30m enablement for Tue to walk best-practices?
Hector (FinOps): Draft plays: 1) soft cap = avg*1.3, hard cap = avg*2; 2) 3-day credit to cover transition; 3) move heavy analytics to nightly batch. Conservatively estimated mitigated month ~$21.5k.
Rae (CSM): Good. Noah/Hector — please prepare 2-3 slides: tech plays + numbers. Ivy — send invite and checklist.
Noah (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare playbook with conservative savings estimates and short curl snippets for batching. ETA EOD.
Hector (FinOps): Note renewal risk if runrate >2x baseline for 30d. I'll include runway and credit recommendation in the deck.
Veridian Admin: Confirmed Insights launched May 16. We'll pull logs and have engineers attend enablement.
Rae (CSM): For immediate mitigation we can propose a temporary quota: POST /v1/accounts/veridian/quotas { "daily": 30000 } (example) or route sampling. I'll assemble the QBR slide and circulate tomorrow AM. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
